units.source_text: 相传：醍醐天皇的皇子西宫左大臣高明，一日在庭前赏菊，口吟此诗句。

en.t: It is said that Takaakira, Prince of Emperor Daigo and Minister of the Left of Nishinomiya, was admiring chrysanthemums in his garden one day and recited this line of poetry.

units.source_text: 唐朝的琵琶妙手廉承武的灵魂化作一小儿，从空中飞来，指示他“开后”乃“开尽”之误。

en.t: Then the spirit of Lian Chengwu, a master pipa player of the Tang dynasty, took the form of a small child and flew down from the sky to tell him that "after blooming" was a mistake for "fully bloomed."

units.source_text: 又把秘曲《石上流泉》教给他。

en.t: He also taught him the secret piece "Flowing Spring over Stone."
